Chhattisgarh Signs Two Key MoUs to Strengthen PM GatiShakti Implementation

2026-08-21 The New Indian Express PM GatiShakti, Chhattisgarh, GIS, data layers, infrastructure planning, MoUs, India, geospatial governance
Read the source article

Quick summary

Chhattisgarh state has integrated over 35 departments into the PM GatiShakti platform with 41 mandatory and 600+ additional GIS data layers, signing two new MoUs to strengthen geospatial infrastructure planning.

Key takeaways

  • Chhattisgarh has integrated more than 35 departments into the PM GatiShakti platform
  • The state has mapped 41 mandatory and over 600 additional data layers on the platform
  • 45 use cases and 30 analytical tools have been developed under the platform
  • Two new MoUs have been signed to further strengthen GatiShakti implementation
  • The platform uses GIS-based infrastructure planning for coordinated project execution across departments
